name: Software License Agreement
description: Terms for licensing on-premise or self-hosted software, covering the licence grant, usage restrictions, support, warranties and liability.

coverPage.title: Software License Agreement
coverPage.intro: This Software License Agreement (the “Agreement”) consists of: (1) this Cover Page (“**Cover Page**”) and (2) the Common Paper Software License Agreement Standard Terms (“**Standard Terms**”). Any modifications of the Standard Terms should be made on the Cover Page, which will control over conflicts with the Standard Terms.
coverPage.attestation: By signing this Cover Page, each party agrees to enter into this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
coverPage.attribution: Common Paper Software License Agreement free to use under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

fields.label: Provider
fields.prompt: the licensor's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address.

fields.label: Customer
fields.prompt: the licensee's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.prompt: the date the agreement starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

fields.label: Order Date
fields.prompt: the date this order starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.prompt: how long the licence runs before it renews, such as "12 months".

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.prompt: how much notice is needed not to renew, such as "60 days before the Subscription Period ends".

fields.label: Permitted Uses
fields.prompt: what the customer is licensed to do with the software.

fields.label: License Limits
fields.prompt: any limits on the licence, such as a seat or installation count.

fields.label: Payment Process
fields.prompt: how and when fees are invoiced and paid.

fields.label: Warranty Period
fields.prompt: how long the provider warrants the software works as documented, such as "90 days" or "the Subscription Period". Record it as written; it is not always a number of years.

fields.label: Deletion Procedure
fields.prompt: how the customer must remove the software when the licence ends.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.prompt: the full name of the US state whose law governs, such as "Delaware". Always a state, never a country or a city.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.prompt: the courts that hear disputes, such as "the state and federal courts located in New Castle County, Delaware".

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.prompt: the most either party can be made to pay, such as "$100,000" or "the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim".

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.prompt: which kinds of claim carry a higher cap, if any. Usually none.

fields.label: Increased Cap Amount
fields.prompt: the higher cap that applies to Increased Claims, if there are any.

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.prompt: which kinds of claim have no cap at all, if any. Usually none.

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.prompt: the third-party claims the provider indemnifies the customer against, beyond the standard ones. Usually none.

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.prompt: the third-party claims the customer indemnifies the provider against, beyond the standard ones. Usually none.

fields.label: Additional Warranties
fields.prompt: any warranties beyond the standard terms. Usually none.
